title: Prefrontal cortex is a key node but not the exclusive site

statements.text: The prefrontal cortex is a key node of the workspace but not its exclusive territory: other hubs such as anterior temporal cortex, cingulate cortex and precuneus may be equally important.

sources.quote: it is not proposed as the exclusive territory for conscious access
Other cortical hubs, such as the anterior temporal cortex, anterior and posterior cingulate cortex, and precuneus, may be equally important.
